report.title: {Items.Count} configuration {Plural(Items.Count, 'profile is', 'profiles are')} in conflict on devices

messages.businessImpact: Two policies are telling the same device different things, so neither setting is reliably in force and the outcome varies by device.
remediation: Identify the setting in conflict and decide which policy owns it.
Remove the setting from the other policies rather than changing its value, so ownership is unambiguous.
